quote.text: Men exist for the sake of one another. Teach them then or bear with them.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • In raising children, recognize that every interaction is an opportunity: guide them gently through instruction, much like cultivating wisdom in the young, so that they learn the value of compassion and communal growth.
    • Understand that, as a parent, patience is as vital as teaching; when mistakes occur, bear with them lovingly while reinforcing lessons that will shape their character and future interactions.
  • Leadership
    • In leadership, see every team member as an integral part of the whole; your role is to impart knowledge and values, forging a culture where collective improvement is the norm.
    • When challenges and errors arise, practice forbearance—remember that true leadership involves both guiding with insight and accepting human frailty with empathy and resilience.
  • Product Management
    • Approach your work in product management as a shared journey: foster a collaborative environment where ideas are nurtured, and mentorship is provided to everyone involved.
    • Balance the drive to innovate with the need to listen and learn from your team; sometimes you must teach and sometimes simply bear with the process, trusting that every step contributes to the broader success.
